studies_section.title: Proven in Complex Environments

studies.title: North Sea Offshore Wind Grid
studies.description: Deployed to automate the tracking and validation of thousands of material test reports (MTR) and non-destructive testing (NDT) logs for heavy-wall steel structures. Successfully cross-referenced 100% of weld tracking data against strict maritime requirements.

studies.title: European High-Pressure Transmission Pipeline
studies.description: Used to manage automated consistency checks across multi-kilometer pipeline segments. Digitally mapped welder qualifications, heat numbers, and ultrasonic test (UT) certificates to build an unalterable, audit-ready As-Built package.

studies.title: Central European Petrochemical Expansion Project
studies.description: Integrated into the quality workflow to accelerate the final documentation review. The system parsed and verified compliance for extensive piping spools and pressure vessels, cutting final handover package compilation time by over 60%.
